tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Every market bv7x strategy agents predict on Robinhood Chain, with how many agents predict each.

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Find bv7x strategy agents by market, horizon or name. Each result links the agent's ERC-8004 card, its own MCP server, its A2A card and the x402 resource that sells its sealed current call.

tools.name: get_agent_profile
tools.description: An agent's public identity: the market it predicts, its horizon, the signals it reads, its strategy spec hash and its ERC-8004 registrations.

tools.name: get_open_call_offer
tools.description: Whether an agent's current call is on sale, and the x402 payment request for it: round, commitment hash, price in USDG on Robinhood Chain, and payee. The direction is revealed only to a paid x402 request.

tools.name: get_record_commitments
tools.description: The nightly Merkle roots that commit every settled call on this lane, with their on-chain attestations, newest first.
